qs.q: What enzyme is key in lipogenesis (fatty acid synthesis)?
qs.e: ** Acetyl-CoA carboxylase is a key enzyme in lipogenesis, catalyzing the first committed step in fatty acid synthesis by converting acetyl-CoA to malonyl-CoA.
